title: Shattered Geometric Totem
description: A mixed-media abstract painting on a black background featuring a large central circular composition with radiating colorful shards in yellow, cyan, pink, and green. The center contains a torn, irregular black void surrounded by geometric symbols, a red sun-like target, and fragmented white panels with black line art including triangles and runes. Paint drips and splatters are visible throughout.
prompt: abstract mixed media painting on black background, large circular geometric emblem exploding into colorful angular shards of yellow, cyan, pink and green, central torn black void, red sun target symbol, fragmented white panels with black sacred geometry triangles and runes, paint splatters and drips, high contrast, energetic composition
